windows.name: Windows x64
windows.notes: Built from feat/unified-renderer-electron-2026-11-25: unified renderer default, Privacy & data screen, Settings updates panel, Cowork chat with provider/model selection, zip file attachments.
windows.installation: Run Keel-Setup-0.1.1.exe. Accept the installer prompts. Launch from the Start Menu shortcut or Desktop shortcut. Your ~/.keel data is preserved on uninstall.

macos.name: macOS arm64 (Apple Silicon, PKG)
macos.notes: macOS .pkg (Apple Silicon, Keel-0.1.1-macos-arm64.pkg) is not published in this round; there is no public URL to download it yet.
macos.installation: Open Keel-0.1.1-macos-arm64.pkg (Apple Silicon) or Keel-0.1.1-macos-x64.pkg (Intel). The installer places Keel in /Applications. If Gatekeeper blocks first launch, right-click Keel and choose Open.

linux.name: Linux x86_64 (DEB)
linux.notes: Linux DEB/AppImage is not published in this round; there is no public URL to download it yet.
linux.installation: Debian/Ubuntu: install Keel-0.1.1-linux-amd64.deb with your package manager. Fedora/RHEL: install Keel-0.1.1-linux-x86_64.rpm. Launch Keel from your desktop's application menu.
